scenarios.task: Replace a cracked exterior glass panel on the curved granite-and-glass facade above the main reading room.
steps: Stage panel in padded crate on shore side
Rig panel to vacuum lifter and inspect seals
Load-test swing stage anchor points
Raise panel and set into glazed frame
Install setting blocks and perimeter seals
Torque retainers to spec and log serial number

rubric.pass_if: Vacuum seals tested and load tag verified before lift
Panel edges protected and handled with suction, never bare hands
Harness tied off to approved anchor 100% of exposure time
Halts work if sustained wind exceeds facade lift limit

scenarios.robot_role: Carries sealant cartridges and fasteners up staging to keep hands free at the panel.

scenarios.task: Pull and terminate a new branch circuit for task lighting in the reading bays without disrupting live circuits.
steps: Obtain LOTO permit and lock out panel
Verify de-energized with meter, test the meter
Fish wire through existing conduit runs
Pull conductors with proper lube and no overfills
Terminate at receptacles and panel breaker
Megger test circuit, remove lock, re-energize and verify

rubric.pass_if: LOTO applied and verified before any conductor work
Conduit fill and breaker sizing within code
Insulation resistance tested and documented before re-energizing

scenarios.task: Clean fouled chilled-water coils and replace filters on air handlers serving climate-controlled archive spaces.
steps: Isolate AHU electrically and valve off water side
Confirm zero energy and post confined-space entry permit
Remove side panels and inspect coil condition
Apply coil cleaner, dwell, and rinse to drain
Replace filters and clean condensate pan tablets
Reassemble, restore valves, and run functional test

rubric.pass_if: Electrical and mechanical energy isolated before entry
SDS reviewed and eyewash within reach during cleaner use
Static pressure and temps return to spec after restart

scenarios.task: Inspect and clear fouling from the library's seawater intake screens in Alexandria's Eastern Harbour.
steps: Hold dive safety meeting with tender and standby diver
Confirm intake pumps locked out and tagged
Descend on downline and orient to screen grid
Clear fouling with hand tools, bag debris
Check screen fasteners and anode condition
Surface on schedule, decompress per tables, debrief

rubric.pass_if: Intake pumps confirmed locked out before water entry
Continuous two-way comms and tender logs checks
Fully dressed standby diver at the station the entire dive

scenarios.task: Cut out and repoint failing grout joints on the seafront plaza overlooking the bay before a charter review event.
steps: Set up dust extraction and wet-cutting controls
Tape off work area and route pedestrian detour
Rake out failed joints to sound material
Vacuum slurry and dampen joints
Mix grout, pack joints, and tool flush
Cure with cover and inspect next shift

rubric.pass_if: Wet cutting or extraction used; no dry sweeping
Barricades and signage keep pedestrians clear
Joints full, tooled, and cured per spec

scenarios.task: Rig and inspect a suspended scaffold for facade maintenance over the main entrance canopy at height.
steps: Verify canopy load rating with engineer of record
Install beam clamps and torque to spec
Rig hoist lines and counterweights, apply tags
Load-test scaffold at 125% working load
Inspect wire rope, brakes, and guardrails
Complete green tag and shift handoff sheet

rubric.pass_if: Canopy capacity verified in writing before loading
Proof load held with no creep before personnel board
Current inspection tag displayed and signed

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a load cell and camera to confirm clamp torque and rope condition at anchor points.

scenarios.task: Rebuild a corroded sump pump and check-valve assembly in the below-grade services level near the harbor waterline.
steps: Set up ventilation and monitor pit atmosphere
Lock out pump circuit and valve off discharge
Rig pump hoist and lift assembly from pit
Replace wear ring, impeller, and gaskets
Reinstall, valve in, and air-free the line
Run amp-draw test against nameplate and log

rubric.pass_if: Pit ventilated and gas readings recorded before entry
Circuit locked and discharge valved before rigging
Amp draw and flow within nameplate tolerance

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries small parts and torque wrench between pit and tool crib to reduce ladder trips.
